payload.entry: Verified all 4 phases against plan:202611/bank_row_notes.md and the epic's commits (bob-cli baca8701, dfe20ca3, fc27bf1a; bob-plugins 1731913b, d9fe19d8, 303e5dbf, 604c8a9a): note_cleaner.json is byte-identical in both repos; the Rust five-step cleaner, shared-vector test, and naming.rs payee regression are present; the plugin has disjoint noteSpan/noteMarkerSpan/noteEditable, 🔁 insertion before the flag or note, and whole-row $ protection; the caption renders in Live Preview, Reading view, and the queue card with contrast CSS. bankNoteNormalize, bankNoteWritePlan (with the round-trip self-check), and bankNoteStagePreview are in place. Space/-/Delete and restricted-Enter keys match the design (with a loading flag); bankNoteCommit applies one isolateHistory whole-line edit, reports the save outcome, keeps the cursor, re-captures context, re-anchors the walk, and counts session.notes without filing or advancing. Bank: note this row works. Docs and glossary:bank-row follow the decisions (no keymap decision record). LANDING FIXES (bob-plugins): (1) the normalizer now reports the concrete rewritten text per change ('[[people/max|Max]] → Max', deduped), matching the design's chip example (was oo.4 PROPOSED FOLLOW-UP #2), with a new note-write test and an updated stage chip assertion; (2) trimmed docs/bob-ledger-tools.md from 6033 to 5996 lint words. oo.2's caption sentence had pushed it over the 6000 cap (the epic's own DISCOVERED ISSUE note). INTEGRATION: om.10's prose-field role lint (c2e28cad) landed mid-epic, so the note-stage input now declares 'bob-text: literal' (bank fields never complete [[ per both plans); rebuilt and deployed bob-ledger-tools via bob plugins sync (no -F). No other post-start bob-cli or bob-plugins commit touches bank code. GATES: bob-cli just check passes; 133 targeted bank/prose-role tests pass; full npm test 8412/8419, with only 3 perf budgets failing at load avg 134 (all pass isolated); bob-ledger-tools docs lint is clean, and only bob-navigation-hotkeys.md (6307, bob-cli-ob, om's DISCOVERED ISSUE) still fails. Real-Obsidian bank e2e not run: no Obsidian binary on this host; the --self-test passes. FOLLOW-UPS: oo.1#1 vault-format overage was already fixed by cb9f8fad (note on bob-cli-oc), and plugin-apis is a warning tracked by bob-cli-ob. oo.2#1 deploy is resolved by later syncs and this landing. oo.2#2 and oo.4#1: ledger-tools was fixed here; nav-hotkeys +1'd on bob-cli-ob. oo.2#3, oo.3 and oo.4#3 perf flakes +1'd on bob-cli-km and bob-cli-io. oo.4#2 was fixed here. Two new DISCOVERED ISSUE notes on active epic bob-cli-om: the prose-role scanner misses bankCategoryUiAppend sites, and the R9 40 ms CPU perf gate flakes under load. No --epic-symbol entries.
